title: Center State Engineering
description:
centerstateengineering.com zoominfo.com/c/center-state-engineering/368448599 340GB Center State Engineering is a privately held civil engineering consultancy founded in 1997 and based in Monroe Township, New Jersey.
It serves municipal and private clients with engineering, surveying, land planning, inspection, and construction management.
Its work includes roads, drainage, stormwater systems, utilities, parks, public facilities, and land development.
Public records show recurring municipal assignments in Monroe Township, South Plainfield, and South Brunswick.
Third-party company profiles estimate its workforce at approximately 15–16 employees; the company does not publish an official headcount.
Datanyze estimates annual revenue at about $7.4 million, but this is an unverified estimate, not company-reported financial data.
Its strongest publicly documented experience is municipal infrastructure and public-facility work in central New Jersey.
